items.text: Puka Nacua officially Q for MNF vs NYG (hip/groin soreness after Thursday practice, different from camp); will not practice Saturday; likely pregame decision. Whittington doubtful (quad).
items.why: Hip/groin soreness post-Thursday; DNP Fri/Sat; McVay notes not camp-related but GTD.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; risk starting if no clear active news.
items.opportunity: If OUT + Whittington out, TE (Ferguson/Parkinson) and depth WR (Mumpfield/Fields) bumps; Adams still primary.

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs NO due to hamstring; previously doubtful.
items.why: Hamstring from Week 1; limited/DNP then downgrade Saturday.
items.implication: Sit Flowers; BAL WR hierarchy shifts to depth/Bateman/Andrews.
items.opportunity: Elevated TE/WR usage; Mark Andrews target share bump; Ja'Kobi Lane also OUT.

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT (hamstring) for Week 2 vs CIN after missing practices; Texans WR room thinned.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP week practices; official OUT confirmed by team/PR and insiders.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; HOU pass volume redistributes to remaining WRs/TE.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Dalton Schultz and depth WRs (Boutte/Hutchinson).

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT or DOUBTFUL (knee) for LV vs LAC; Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White.
items.why: Knee; limited Friday; game-time test possible but prepare for absence.
items.implication: Do not start Bowers; stream TE alternative in early windows.
items.opportunity: Myarick elevation; residual targets to Jeanty/WRs if inactive.

items.text: Joe Burrow listed Q (back) but expected/good to go vs HOU; Bengals elevated Josh Johnson as precaution. Coach/Taylor indications positive.
items.why: Back; said playing; full-ish practice path; elevation insurance.
items.implication: Start Burrow with confidence; confirm inactives.
items.opportunity: Full CIN offense online including Chase/Higgins/Brown.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT (foot) for Sunday vs NE.
items.why: Foot; LP-DNP-DNP path then Saturday downgrade.
items.implication: Sit Pittman; PIT WR targets to Metcalf/others.
items.opportunity: DK Metcalf volume increase; Rodgers deep-shot rate elevated.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; Q status affects Justin Herbert and many LAC projections; game at 4pm ET. Practiced limited Friday.
items.why: Ribs from Week 1; missed early practices, limited return Friday; biggest slate impact per Levitan.
items.implication: Monitor inactives closely; Herbert ceiling tied to McConkey availability.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Quentin Johnston role expansion; if IN, McConkey still volume WR1/2.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for debut; Pats desperately need playmakers—do they give him 10+ touches vs Stevenson? Brown IR + schedule factors.
items.why: Listed IN on ETR board; NE playmaker need; Brown IR opens opportunity.
items.implication: Monitor for 10+ touch role; flex/handcuff upside in debut.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes share vs Stevenson; goal-line potential if expanded.

items.text: Alvin Kamara expected IN/back; Travis Etienne hate due to Week 1 reduced workload (matched Miller rushes) + Kamara squeeze on passing downs; NO underdog script.
items.why: Kamara return confirmed IN on boards; Etienne W1 air-heavy but committee risk.
items.implication: Fade Etienne; Kamara reclaims third-down/pass work.
items.opportunity: Kamara snaps/routes expansion; Etienne early-down only possible.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey getting projection bump off Week 1 usage regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) Q status still matters for committee.
items.why: Strong W1 usage data; Black Q could limit committee.
items.implication: CMC remains elite RB1; monitor Black for pure monopoly.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry/target share expansion if Black limited.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24%+ target share (tied lead), 74% snaps, 40% routes targeted in W1 with KC; elite util vs IND (allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry).
items.why: W1 target share 24% career-high-ish; Indy run defense soft; Kubiak/Chiefs usage.
items.implication: Lock-in RB1; massive season range if healthy.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/RZ share continuation; pass-game weapon.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: 26% target share W1, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell; vs CLE soft vs RBs.
items.why: Career-high tgt share; 100% RZ RB work; route edge over Gainwell.
items.implication: RB2 upside with pass + goal-line role.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE: 37% tgt share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG avg in 6 career Wentz games; Bears D soft vs WRs last week.
items.why: Elite share with Wentz; historical production; matchup.
items.implication: WR1 lock even with QB change.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: 99 utilization score W1 (2nd only to Bijan); 19% tgt share last 10; Kubiak offense; @ LAC soft run D.
items.why: Elite W1 util 99; consistent pass involvement; injury scare overblown.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex start; volume floor high.
items.opportunity: Touches + targets; Bowers absence could funnel more.
